name: Paragraph locator
description: Tracks where paragraphs are used across the site.
project_description:
This module is designed to help Drupal administrators and content managers efficiently manage paragraph types and their usage within the site. Below, you'll find detailed information on how to use the various features of this module.

 Features 
 
 Helps to locate paragraphs 
 Helps to Modify paragraphs and other entities 
 Helps to delete the paragraphs 
 
 Post-Installation 
 You can find the link to the Paragraph Locator dashboard under - /admin/config/content/

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires the following modules:

 Paragraphs 

 Back to top
